title: NBN POI 4KLG (Petrie), 4CAB (Caboolture), 4APL (Aspley) - Infrastructure Upgrades
current_summary: Planned NBN maintenance at POIs 4KLG (Petrie), 4CAB (Caboolture) and 4APL (Aspley), scheduled for 13 August 2026 11:00 PM to 14 August 2026 6:00 AM AEST, has been cancelled. No customer impact is expected.

updates.content: The planned NBN maintenance for the Petrie, Caboolture and Aspley POIs, previously scheduled for Thursday 13 August from 11:00 PM to Friday 14 August 6:00 AM AEST, has been cancelled. There will be no impact to services during this time. Thank you for your understanding.
